review.description: Eleven entity contracts add or change retained-review behavior: W-RUN-CONTROLS, W-LAUNCH-EDITOR, W-LAUNCH-REVIEW, W-QUESTIONS, W-REPOSITORY-SETTINGS, W-SYSTEM-DEFAULTS, W-PR-REVIEW-POLICY, W-RETAINED-REVIEW, C-PR-POSTING-POLICY, C-REVIEW-PUBLISH and C-REVIEW-RECONCILE. The other 123 direct analyzer entries retain their entity behavior and are reviewed structurally for shared mapped-file, assertion-description or instance-composition impact. Each contract below has an explicit decision; no adoption is claimed. Main sidebar, saved-state, history and skill-load identities remain intact.
review.implementation: Compared current and main model/entity/assertion/instance records and inspected changed app, transport, store and web paths. Analyzer direct scope includes any changed mapped file, so broad web/src/main.tsx references also select unchanged connection/package panes. Its review delta changes lazy imports and ItemDetail/Launch/Agent; it does not change their package/connection semantics. New child composition and expanded metadata-only journal assertion descriptions retain structural ownership. Behavioral children below retain related actual code and meaningful tests; native execution remains gated on ordered iteration/durable waits. Finished saved-result recovery now validates its artifact/current evidence and returns before reopening posting, preserving retained completion and explicit artifact authority after lost parent finalization. Rechecked against target main 9245bc58: report-detail definitions/disposition assertions and report source consumers remain exact baseline matches; only retained PR-review contract behavior is classified behavioral. Cycle two preserves newer policy observations over older save replies, projects compact review counts/outcomes rather than full finding prose and recognizes only an exact durable own publication during finished/uncertain recovery. Reviewer readiness no longer exposes completion before engineering assessment and durable result binding. The actual initial-inbox/queue ListWithout facade now compacts legacy review findings before SQL-to-Go transfer.
review.tests: Read the retained review, policy/import/editor race, material-answer, lifecycle/receipt and saved invalidation assertions described per behavioral child. Unchanged children retain their existing owned assertion inventories and explicit gaps; shared test-file edits are not treated as proof of a new child behavior. P-CONNECTION-GUIDE/P-PACKAGE-OVERVIEW retain unchanged native consent/package/landing assertions and need no unrelated test edits. Registry validation and the read-only review-constraint audit are separate from the coordinator pending full verification; host/accessibility gaps remain open. API-REVIEW-FINISHED-RECOVERY is owned by W-RUN-CONTROLS, W-RETAINED-REVIEW and C-REVIEW-PUBLISH; its SQLite failure/restart assertion checks the same complete artifact, zero automatic remote calls and one later explicit post. Preserved the exact target-main two-case invalid/resolved report-disposition browser assertion alongside the appended retained-review cases. New owned assertions cover delayed policy success/failure ordering, SQL-before-decode/initial UI compactness and real own-publication recovery; strict clean rendering requires a known zero finding count. These refine the same eleven behavior contracts; the other children retain their semantic classifications. API-REVIEW-COMPLETION-BOUNDARY verifies the real restarted aggregate-write failure keeps an older artifact incomplete/unpostable, then succeeds from saved checkpoints. API-REVIEW-COMPACT-SQL now probes real ListWithout/Select bytes before domain conversion; final UI payload checks are not substituted for that intermediate proof.
